import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime

SOURCE_FILE = 'source.json'

def read_json(filename):
    with open(filename, 'r') as f:
        return json.load(f)

def format_decimal(d):
    return f"{d:.2f}"

def main():
    data = read_json(SOURCE_FILE)
    partners = read_json('partners.json')
    
    ns = {
        '': 'urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:Invoice-2',
        'cac': 'urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:CommonAggregateComponents-2',
        'cbc': 'urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:CommonBasicComponents-2'
    }
    
    ET.register_namespace('', ns[''])
    ET.register_namespace('cac', ns['cac'])
    ET.register_namespace('cbc', ns['cbc'])
    
    invoice = ET.Element(f'{{{ns[""]}}}Invoice')
    
    def E(tag, text=None):
        elem = ET.SubElement(invoice, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}{tag}')
        if text is not None:
            elem.text = text
        return elem
    
    def CAC(tag):
        return ET.SubElement(invoice, f'{{{ns["cac"]}}}{tag}')
    
    E('CustomizationID', 'urn:cen.eu:en16931:2017#compliant#urn:fdc:peppol.eu:2017:poacc:billing:3.0')
    E('ProfileID', 'urn:fdc:peppol.eu:2017:poacc:billing:01:1.0')
    E('ID', data['number'])
    E('IssueDate', datetime.utcfromtimestamp(data['created']).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
    E('DueDate', datetime.utcfromtimestamp(data['due_date']).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
    E('InvoiceTypeCode', '380')
    E('DocumentCurrencyCode', data['currency'].upper())
    E('BuyerReference', partners['buyer']['buyer_reference'])
    
    supplier = CAC('AccountingSupplierParty')
    party = CAC('cac:Party')
    supplier.append(party)
    endpoint = ET.SubElement(party, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}EndpointID', {'schemeID': partners['seller']['endpoint']['scheme']})
    endpoint.text = partners['seller']['endpoint']['id']
    pname = CAC('cac:PartyName')
    party.append(pname)
    ET.SubElement(pname, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Name').text = partners['seller']['name']
    address = CAC('cac:PostalAddress')
    party.append(address)
    ET.SubElement(address, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}StreetName').text = partners['seller']['street']
    ET.SubElement(address, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}CityName').text = partners['seller']['city']
    ET.SubElement(address, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}PostalZone').text = partners['seller']['postcode']
    country = CAC('cac:Country')
    address.append(country)
    ET.SubElement(country, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}IdentificationCode').text = partners['seller']['country']
    tax_scheme = CAC('cac:PartyTaxScheme')
    party.append(tax_scheme)
    ET.SubElement(tax_scheme, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}CompanyID').text = partners['seller']['vat']
    ts = CAC('cac:TaxScheme')
    tax_scheme.append(ts)
    ET.SubElement(ts, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'VAT'
    
    customer = CAC('AccountingCustomerParty')
    party = CAC('cac:Party')
    customer.append(party)
    endpoint = ET.SubElement(party, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}EndpointID', {'schemeID': partners['buyer']['endpoint']['scheme']})
    endpoint.text = partners['buyer']['endpoint']['id']
    pname = CAC('cac:PartyName')
    party.append(pname)
    ET.SubElement(pname, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Name').text = data['customer_name']
    address = CAC('cac:PostalAddress')
    party.append(address)
    ET.SubElement(address, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}StreetName').text = data['customer_address']['line1']
    ET.SubElement(address, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}CityName').text = data['customer_address']['city']
    ET.SubElement(address, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}PostalZone').text = data['customer_address']['postal_code']
    country = CAC('cac:Country')
    address.append(country)
    ET.SubElement(country, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}IdentificationCode').text = data['customer_address']['country']
    tax_scheme = CAC('cac:PartyTaxScheme')
    party.append(tax_scheme)
    ET.SubElement(tax_scheme, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}CompanyID').text = data['customer_tax_ids'][0]['value']
    ts = CAC('cac:TaxScheme')
    tax_scheme.append(ts)
    ET.SubElement(ts, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'VAT'
    
    payment = CAC('PaymentMeans')
    invoice.append(payment)
    ET.SubElement(payment, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}PaymentMeansCode', {'name': 'Credit transfer'}).text = '30'
    ET.SubElement(payment, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}PaymentID').text = data['number']
    account = CAC('cac:PayeeFinancialAccount')
    payment.append(account)
    ET.SubElement(account, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = partners['seller']['iban']
    
    allowance_charge = CAC('AllowanceCharge')
    invoice.append(allowance_charge)
    ET.SubElement(allowance_charge, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ChargeIndicator').text = 'false'
    ET.SubElement(allowance_charge, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}AllowanceChargeReason').text = 'Discount'
    disc_amount = Decimal(data['total_discount_amounts'][0]['amount']) / 100
    ET.SubElement(allowance_charge, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Amount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(disc_amount)
    tax_cat = CAC('cac:TaxCategory')
    allowance_charge.append(tax_cat)
    ET.SubElement(tax_cat, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'S'
    ET.SubElement(tax_cat, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Percent').text = str(data['default_tax_rates'][0]['percentage'])
    ts = CAC('cac:TaxScheme')
    tax_cat.append(ts)
    ET.SubElement(ts, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'VAT'
    
    tax_total = CAC('TaxTotal')
    invoice.append(tax_total)
    total_tax = Decimal(data['total_taxes'][0]['amount']) / 100
    ET.SubElement(tax_total, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}TaxAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(total_tax)
    subtotal = CAC('cac:TaxSubtotal')
    tax_total.append(subtotal)
    taxable_amount = Decimal(data['total_excluding_tax']) / 100
    ET.SubElement(subtotal, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}TaxableAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(taxable_amount)
    ET.SubElement(subtotal, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}TaxAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(total_tax)
    tax_cat = CAC('cac:TaxCategory')
    subtotal.append(tax_cat)
    ET.SubElement(tax_cat, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'S'
    ET.SubElement(tax_cat, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Percent').text = str(data['default_tax_rates'][0]['percentage'])
    ts = CAC('cac:TaxScheme')
    tax_cat.append(ts)
    ET.SubElement(ts, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'VAT'
    
    monetary = CAC('LegalMonetaryTotal')
    invoice.append(monetary)
    line_ext_amount = Decimal(data['subtotal']) / 100
    ET.SubElement(monetary, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}LineExtensionAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(line_ext_amount)
    ET.SubElement(monetary, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}TaxExclusiveAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(taxable_amount)
    total_inc = Decimal(data['total']) / 100
    ET.SubElement(monetary, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}TaxInclusiveAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(total_inc)
    ET.SubElement(monetary, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}AllowanceTotalAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(disc_amount)
    ET.SubElement(monetary, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}PayableAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(total_inc)
    
    for idx, line in enumerate(data['lines']['data'], start=1):
        il = CAC('InvoiceLine')
        invoice.append(il)
        ET.SubElement(il, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = str(idx)
        qty = Decimal(line['quantity'])
        ET.SubElement(il, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}InvoicedQuantity', {'unitCode': 'EA'}).text = str(qty)
        ext_amount = Decimal(line['subtotal']) / 100
        ET.SubElement(il, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}LineExtensionAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(ext_amount)
        item = CAC('cac:Item')
        il.append(item)
        ET.SubElement(item, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Description').text = line['description']
        ET.SubElement(item, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Name').text = line['description']
        tax_cat = CAC('cac:ClassifiedTaxCategory')
        item.append(tax_cat)
        ET.SubElement(tax_cat, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'S'
        ET.SubElement(tax_cat, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}Percent').text = str(data['default_tax_rates'][0]['percentage'])
        ts = CAC('cac:TaxScheme')
        tax_cat.append(ts)
        ET.SubElement(ts, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}ID').text = 'VAT'
        price = CAC('cac:Price')
        il.append(price)
        unit_price = Decimal(line['pricing']['unit_amount_decimal']) / 100
        ET.SubElement(price, f'{{{ns["cbc"]}}}PriceAmount', {'currencyID': data['currency'].upper()}).text = format_decimal(unit_price)
    
    tree = ET.ElementTree(invoice)
    tree.write('out.xml', encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
